Bangladesh Seeks Balanced Ties, Diversifying Relations Beyond India

Bangladesh is seeking to reset its bilateral relations and reduce its perceived over-reliance on India, aiming for more balanced ties. This shift involves exploring closer engagement with China, which is seen as a move to navigate a complex geopolitical landscape. The Bangladeshi government has expressed a desire to move beyond what it calls an "India fascination" to foster broader international partnerships. This strategic recalibration aims to build robust relationships with multiple global partners, including China, to enhance its foreign policy and economic opportunities.
